checks: Config exact SHA and stable regular lstat/hash/lstat; canonical non-symlink absolute config path must equal fixed reviewed input.
Source entries canonical repository-relative and selected paths strictly acquisition/qualification; unique additions cannot collide with inherited entries.

Every inherited and selected entry is a committed regular blob (100644/100755), exact current regular non-symlink working bytes equal committed bytes. Inherited SHA/role/entry fields preserved unchanged.
New entries typed role release-input. Real pinned normalizers must return exact sorted combined entries.
Module definitions execute from already verified source bytes under temporary sys.modules names, then are removed; full validators/loaders are never called.
Stable source/config signatures and hashes plus live HEAD rechecked after normalization/inventory.
Complete explicit unselected eligible committed inventory; nonregular entries remain visibly excluded rather than automatically admitted.
Output fixed path with exclusive xb creation/fsync; existing output rejected.

inputs.source_requirement: Exact40hexsource_commit must equal config.source_commit and live committed HEAD at entry and exit. No fixed future source hash is invented.

limitations: Production input config does not yet exist at review time and source14 commit is not fabricated.
No production collector main or source collection invoked.
Self-review of candidate plus focused tests only; independent final review remains for root before execution.

output.compatibility: Legacy unselected_eligible_committed_paths remains a sorted string list; separate unselected_committed_inventory records exact Git mode/object/type/bytes/hash and regular-file eligibility.

synthetic_near_misses: unknown config fields, malformed inherited roles/hashes, duplicate inherited entries
dirty inherited or selected working bytes
wrong frozen module even when committed
committed selected symlink and unselected nonregular inventory

test.scope: Isolated miniature temporary Git repositories; actual immutable executor._source_inputs + bridge08._resolve_replacement_source_inputs invoked, no replacement full validator/replay/materialization/admission/build/analyzer. Synthetic commits only inside disposable fixture repositories; production Git untouched.
